branch: fullness: A=98.39 is above the 95% fullness bar; the swap I/O branch was also true
culprit: example-a.service, a host systemd unit on host-a.example, not a container: a page-cache burst while it read the whole boot's journal
mechanism: a package upgrade restarted example-a.service mid-uptime; its journal read pulled about 1 GB into page cache, attributed to the unit's cgroup, and idle container pages were swapped out in one step; not a leak
fix: make example-a.service run at boot only, cap the journal size, and grow swap
notes: one-off per event, but it recurs on every upgrade of that package
